questions.question:
Este es el prompt (en inglés) que usaré para generar la especificación. ¿Lo apruebas?

---
Feature: Pause and resume a listing

WHY: Sellers on the marketplace want to temporarily take a listing off sale (out of stock, on vacation) and bring it back later without losing the rank it has earned. Today a listing can only be `active`; deleting and re-publishing it would reset its rank to zero.

WHAT:
- Add two actions to the listings API: `POST /listings/:id/pause` and `POST /listings/:id/resume`.
- A paused listing has status `paused`. Resuming sets it back to `active`.
- Who may act: the seller who owns the listing, and any admin. Anyone else (other sellers, buyers, unauthenticated callers) is refused. It does not matter who paused it: the owner or any admin may resume it.
- Rank: pausing and resuming never change the listing's rank score; it is preserved exactly. Its position in search after resuming is NOT guaranteed — other listings may have overtaken it while it was paused.
- While paused: the listing does not appear in search results for anyone, including its own seller; it refuses new orders; looking it up by id still answers and shows status `paused`.
- Orders already placed on the listing before it was paused are untouched; the orders listing behaves exactly as today.
- Repeated or out-of-place actions (pausing an already paused listing, resuming an already active one) succeed and change nothing.
- Unknown listing ids answer as the API does today for unknown listings.
- The two new actions must be reachable through the running server's published routes, not only in-process.
- Standing project rules: this feature sets aside, for this feature only, the rules "a listing has a single status, `active`" and "only admins change a listing's status". Exact error codes and success bodies are left to implementation, in the API's existing error style: a JSON body { "error": "<snake_case_code>" } with a 4xx status.

Surfaces in scope: search, listing detail, placing an order, the published route table, the new pause/resume actions. Out of scope: the orders listing (unchanged).

Non-goals: a "my listings" view for sellers; a history of who paused/resumed; scheduled or automatic pauses; cancelling or changing existing orders; any change to how rank is earned.

References: none — build on the existing listings API.

Literals — carry these into the spec exactly as written; do not translate or reword them:
- `POST /listings/:id/pause`
- `POST /listings/:id/resume`
- `paused`
- `active`

Open decisions: none.
---

Este es el borrador completo de goal.md (el objetivo contra el que se verificará el trabajo):

# Goal — pause-listing

## Goal condition
`npm test`, `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` exit 0, and against the running server (`npm start`): `POST /listings/:id/pause` by the owning seller returns 2xx and `GET /listings/:id` then shows `status: "paused"` with the same `rankScore`; the listing is absent from `GET /listings`; `POST /listings/:id/resume` returns 2xx and the listing is back in `GET /listings` with `status: "active"`, at the position its unchanged `rankScore` gives it.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-1 `POST /listings/:id/pause` sets the listing's status to `paused`; `POST /listings/:id/resume` sets it back to `active`. (idea)
- AC-2 Pausing and resuming never change `rankScore`; after resume the listing appears in search at the position its rankScore gives it. (idea, D3)
- AC-3 Only the owning seller or any admin may pause/resume. No user → 401; any other user (other seller, buyer) → 4xx error; unknown listing → 404. Errors use the existing style `{ "error": "<snake_case_code>" }`. (D5, standing S2)
- AC-4 A paused listing is absent from `GET /listings` (with or without `q`). (D3)
- AC-5 `GET /listings/:id` returns a paused listing with `status: "paused"`. (D3)
- AC-6 `POST /listings/:id/orders` on a paused listing is refused with a 4xx error, creates no order and does not change rankScore. (D3)
- AC-7 Pausing an already paused listing, or resuming an active one, answers success with the listing unchanged. (D6)
- AC-8 Orders placed before pausing are unchanged and still listed by `GET /orders` as today. (D8)
- AC-9 Both routes are reachable on the real server (`npm start`), not only in tests. (fact: published route table in src/gateway.ts)

## Constraints
- Existing endpoints behave as today for active listings; existing tests stay green.
- Standing decisions S1 (only admins change status) and S3 (single status `active`) are set aside for this feature only and stay written. (D1, D2)
- Exact error codes and success bodies: implementer's choice within S2.

## Stop when
none (D7)

## Out of scope
- Cancelling or modifying existing orders on pause.
- A 'my listings' endpoint or any other way to list paused listings.
- Any status other than `active` and `paused`.

## Surfaces
- In scope: POST /listings/:id/pause, POST /listings/:id/resume, GET /listings, GET /listings/:id, POST /listings/:id/orders, the published route table.
- Out of scope (unchanged): GET /orders, POST /listings.

## Literals
Carry these exactly as written:
- `POST /listings/:id/pause`
- `POST /listings/:id/resume`
- status `paused`

## References
none (D4)
